info.short_description: Number of students enrolled at the reporting level.
info.long_description: Enrollment count reported by the source. Used as the denominator for the coverage and exemption percentages in the same record.

info.long_name: Proportion of students with a non-medical (personal-belief) vaccination exemption
info.short_description: Proportion of assessed school students with a non-medical exemption (religious, philosophical, or personal-belief) from vaccination requirements.
info.long_description: Share of assessed school students holding a non-medical exemption from one or more required vaccines. The exemption categories permitted differ by state law - some allow religious exemptions only, others also allow philosophical or personal-belief exemptions - and this harmonized field aggregates whichever non-medical categories the state reports.
info.statement: In {location}, {value} of school students had a non-medical vaccination exemption.

info.long_name: Proportion of students with a medical vaccination exemption
info.short_description: Proportion of assessed school students with a medical exemption from one or more required vaccines.
info.long_description: Share of assessed school students with a physician-certified medical exemption from one or more required vaccines, as reported in the state's annual school immunization survey.
info.statement: In {location}, {value} of school students had a medical vaccination exemption.

info.long_name: Proportion of students with no immunization record on file
info.short_description: Proportion of assessed school students for whom no immunization record was on file.
info.long_description: Share of assessed school students with no immunization record at all, which is distinct from having an incomplete record or an exemption.
info.statement: In {location}, {value} of school students had no immunization record on file.

info.long_name: Proportion of students whose record is missing one or more required immunizations
info.short_description: Proportion of enrolled students with an immunization record on file that lacks one or more required immunizations.
info.long_description: Share of enrolled students whose immunization record is on file but incomplete for one or more required vaccines. Distinct from rate_no_record (no record on file at all) and from the exemption rates; Hawaii reports the four categories so that they sum to its not-up-to-date total.
info.statement: In {location}, {value} of school students were missing one or more required immunizations.

info.long_name: Proportion of students not up to date for all required vaccines
info.short_description: Proportion of assessed school students not up to date for every vaccine the state requires.
info.long_description: Share of assessed school students not recorded as up to date across the full required schedule, excluding those conditionally enrolled.
info.statement: In {location}, {value} of school students were not up to date for all required vaccines.
